original.target_description: Primary original paper could not be acquired within the acquisition allowance. DOI publisher returned a 403 challenge; OpenAlex had no best OA location; author site had a TLS hostname mismatch; CiteSeer alternative returned 404. Original statistics summarized in the replication article were not substituted for the primary paper.

replication.target_description: Study 1: between-participant comparison of single-colored versus multicolored Smarties quantity estimates averaged across four containers; independent t test, 206 complete cases.

n.exclusions: Excluded all participants with missing values for at least one quantity estimate; 276 recruited, 206 retained (102 single-colored, 104 multicolored).

reported_success.quote: Contrary to our hypothesis, variety increased instead of decreased the perceived quantity.

notes: Original locator names Study 1 but p. 8 and candy description suggest a different original study; primary original unavailable, so no original test was selected. Replication participants estimated photographs, rather than pouring candy.
